svg.aria-label: Back Up and Restore Argo CD overview. In the argocd namespace, Argo CD v3.6.3 holds Applications, AppProjects, repo credentials, ConfigMaps, and argocd-secret. argocd admin export, run by hand or by a CronJob nightly at 02:00, writes them to argocd-backup.yaml, which must be encrypted and kept out of Git. The file is copied off-cluster to object storage such as S3. argocd admin import loads it into a fresh Argo CD install of the same version: Applications come back Synced and Healthy, AppProjects and repo credentials are created, ConfigMaps are updated, and argocd-secret brings back the old admin password. The guestbook app in its own namespace keeps running the whole time, and the restored Argo CD adopts it without a restart.
svg.title: Back Up and Restore Argo CD: export the argocd namespace, store the encrypted file off-cluster, and import it into a fresh install
svg.text: Back Up and Restore Argo CD
Export, store off-cluster, import into a fresh install
